item.title: Masterclass with Victoria Wyeth at The MAC — Fri Aug 7, 5:00 PM — Napa Valley Museum of Art and Culture
item.description:
Masterclass with Victoria Wyeth at The MAC: Wine Reception with Domaine Carneros invites guests to an after-hours reception featuring wines by Domaine Carneros and a special presentation by Victoria Wyeth, the only granddaughter of renowned artist Andrew Wyeth. Victoria will lead guests through her exhibition, My Andy, featuring candid family photographs and personal stories. She will also explore the artistic techniques and context behind the works on display, along with a deeper look at some of Andrew Wyeth's most celebrated paintings, including Christina's World and Master Bedroom. The event is part of Victoria Wyeth Weekend at The MAC, taking place August 7–9, 2026, alongside The Wyeths: Three Generations | Works from the Bank of America Collection. The weekend offers a rare opportunity to explore the legacy of N.C. Wyeth, Andrew Wyeth, and Jamie Wyeth through Victoria's unique perspective.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Poetry Winemaker Dinner at Cliff Lede Vineyards — Sat Aug 8, 12:00 AM
item.description:
Join Proprietor Jason Lede and Director of Winemaking Christopher Tynan at Cliff Lede Vineyards for an unforgettable Poetry Winemaker Dinner celebrating the art of wine and food. As golden hour lights the vineyards, guests are welcomed to the White Room Terrace overlooking the stunning Stags Leap District. The evening features a thoughtfully curated multi-course menu, each dish expertly paired with Cliff Lede’s acclaimed wines, including an exclusive first taste of the 2023 Poetry. This intimate dining experience continues with a special dessert course served in the tank room, paired with a final selection to beautifully close the evening. A refined celebration of craftsmanship, terroir, and culinary artistry, this is a memorable night in the heart of Napa Valley.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:

We will also touch on the park’s natural history which intersects its human history in often interest

item.title: Cookbook Club — Sat Aug 8, 12:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Regional Library
item.description: Are you interested in trying new recipes or just wanting to get out of your cooking comfort zone? A cookbook book club blends the joy of reading with the creativity of cooking and the warmth of sharing meals. Browse a selection of themed cookbooks every month, then prepare and share your meals for the next meeting! June: Celebrating Julia in June! Julia Child & Those Influenced by Her. Before "food TV" was a genre, Julia Child was teaching America to cook-joyfully, loudly, and with plenty of permission to make mistakes. Her landmark cookbook Mastering the Art of French Cooking helped translate French technique for American home kitchens launching a whole new way of learning to cook. For this meeting, bring a dish by Julia Child or by chefs influenced by her and who share her spirit-like Jacques Pépin, her longtime cooking partner on public television, and Ina Garten, who has spoken about admiring Child's "courage of her convictions." July: Savoring Summer, Italian-Style. Think Italian
